notes: Four ships listed purchasable-with-no-game-file were name mismatches, not missing data.

Ares Inferno/Ion are 'Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno/Ion' in the game files (crus_starfighter_*). Nova Tank is 'Tumbril Nova'. 600i Explorer is the base orig_600i - the site splits Explorer/Touring where the game has 600i + 600i Touring.
Lesson: suffix matching on the display name is not sufficient. Some game names share no words with the site name at all ('Starfighter Inferno' vs 'Ares Inferno').
Both ambiguities resolved 2026-08-02: base file is canonical, variant recorded. Same rule as the tier variants.

The 95 game-only files are now bucketed. 35 are 'collector' special editions whose display names carry Wikelo tags (War/Sneak/Work/Savior/Speedy Special); 7 are Best In Show editions; 18 are named variants of ships already listed. Only the remainder are genuinely unaccounted for.

INTERPRETATION, not data: the Wikelo ships appear to be acquired through an in-game trader rather than bought with aUEC at a dealer. If so they are a whole acquisition route the site does not cover. Verify before publishing anything that says so.
